newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power firm, profits as expected.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power firm, profits as expected.

text.p: Shares in Scottish Power Plc were indicated moderately higher in pre-market trade on Thursday, after annual profits met with analysts expectations.
The shares were up 3-1/2p to 397-1/2p by 0712 GMT.
Pretax profit rose 38 percent to 558.4 million stg from 404.8 a year ago. Analysts had forecast profits of between 538 and 582 million stg.
The total dividend was raised to 18.5p/shr, up from 15.5 last year.
"These results are very much in line," said industry analyst Nigel Hawkins at Yamaichi. "There were no surprises...the dividend was well flagged and the pretax number fell in line with estimates."
"They kept silent on the (new Labour government planned) utility tax, as you'd expect, so the shares will probably stay firm," he added.
